title: VipPolicySetRequest
description: vip.policy-set-request@1: bodies of vip.resource.policy.set on OpenVibe.VIP. POST /api/v1/policies: { resource, creator?, requirement?, plan_id?, perk_key?, sensitive? } creates the creator's rule for a resource, replacing (disabling) the creator's active rule for the same resource; a service names the creator (a user SubjectRef), a person sets rules for themselves. requirement member (default), plan (members of plan_id, one of the creator's plans) or perk (members whose plan version includes perk_key). DELETE /api/v1/policies/:id takes no body and disables the rule. Refusals are problem+json: 422 vip.invalid_input (no EntityRef resource, a bad requirement, the network as creator), vip.plan_not_found or vip.perk_not_found; 404 vip.rule_not_found; 403 capability.denied or vip.not_yours. Unknown fields are ignored.

creator.description: The creator the rule belongs to.

perk_key.description: Required with requirement perk: a key of the creator's perks or the network's.

sensitive.description: Always ask Billing (never the projection) when evaluating.
